items.title: Jasper Taylor Interview, 1959-06-30
items.q: Freddie Kippert was freelancing around Chicago for a long time.

ctx.x: Gave him that idea. Were there many new different tunes that you hadn't heard before the New Orleans fellas played? What they call today like the Dixieland numbers, you know, those things like Tiger Rag and all those. Did they play many of those?

No, we didn't hear anything about Tiger Rag until the, came from New Orleans, and the Liver Stable Blues, and Blue in the Blues, and the Freddie Kippert's Blues. And incidentally, Freddie Kippert was freelancing around Chicago for a long time.
When did you first meet him or hear him?
